meta.title: Kavery Sports Club — Periyaneelavanai, since 1981
meta.description: Cricket, free classes and community in Periyaneelavanai. Live scores from Kavery Sports Club and news from the Kavery Education Development Association.

hero.lead: One club for the cricket ground and the classroom. Follow every ball, and see how the village's children are doing in class.

opening.failed: That didn't go through. Press again.
opening.waiting: Waiting for the chief guest to open the website…

ticker.empty: Fixtures appear here as soon as the season is scheduled.

matches.title: Every ball, as it happens
matches.lead: Our scorers record each delivery from the boundary rope. Scores here update on their own while a match is on.
matches.emptyBody: When the next match is scheduled it will be listed here, and you can turn on a notification for the first ball.

club.title: A village club, {years} seasons on
club.p1: Kavery Sports Club was founded in Periyaneelavanai in 1981. Cricket is where it started and still where the village gathers.
club.p2: In 2023 the club set up an education wing, the Kavery Education Development Association, so that what happens off the field matters as much as what happens on it.
club.pillar1Body: Cricket for the village, scored ball by ball.
club.pillar2Body: Free classes run by KEDA, the club's education wing.
club.pillar3Body: One crest for players, students, parents and members.

keda.title: Free classes. Every child welcome.
keda.lead: KEDA is the club's education wing. It runs free scholarship-exam classes for Grade {grades} students in Periyaneelavanai. There is no fee, now or later.
keda.point1Body: Classes, papers and marking are free for every student.
keda.point2Body: Each class keeps a register, so a child who misses lessons is noticed and followed up.
keda.point3Body: Every exam is recorded per student, so teachers can see who needs help before the scholarship paper.

news.title: From the club
news.empty: News from the club and from KEDA will be posted here.

gallery.title: Seasons in pictures
gallery.empty: Photo albums will appear here once they are uploaded.

app.title: Take Kavery with you
app.lead: Install the site as an app. No app store, nothing to download. Then choose what you want to be told about.
app.on: Notifications are on for this device.
app.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings. Allow them there, then come back.
app.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. Try Chrome on Android, or install the app on iPhone first.
app.iosHint: On iPhone: tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then open Kavery from your home screen and turn on notifications there.
app.installHint: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.

ResultsPage.title: Exam
ResultsPage.description: Enter the index number printed on the student card to see that student's published exam results and progress.
ResultsPage.label: Index number
ResultsPage.hint: Exactly as printed on the student card, including the KEDA prefix.
ResultsPage.empty_body: This student has no published exam results at the moment. Results appear here once the club publishes them, usually a few days after the exam.
ResultsPage.note_body: Only exams the club has published are shown. Averages and ranks exclude papers the student was absent for, and are calculated among the students who sat the same papers.
ResultsPage.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
ResultsPage.meta_title: Exam Results | Kavery Education Development Association
ResultsPage.meta_description: Look up a student's published exam results in KEDA's free classes using the index number on their student card.

Membership.meta_description: Apply for membership of Kavery Sports Club, Periyaneelavanai, or renew the membership you have.
Membership.renew_meta_title: Renew your membership | Kavery Sports Club
Membership.title: Join the club
Membership.lead: Fill in the details below. The club reviews every application and will be in touch.
Membership.closed_title: Applications are not open online at the moment
Membership.closed_body: To become a member, please contact the club directly.
Membership.renew_lead: Enter the phone number and NIC on your membership. Once the club has confirmed it, your membership runs for another year.
Membership.nic_hint: As on the card: nine digits and V or X, or twelve digits.
Membership.photo_hint: A recent photo with the face clearly visible. It is printed on the membership card.
Membership.message: Anything you would like the club to know
Membership.pay_transfer: Pay the fee into the account below, then upload the slip.
Membership.payment_slip_hint: A photo of the bank slip, or a PDF receipt (up to 4 MB).
Membership.consent: I agree that the club may keep these details to manage my membership. (For an applicant under 18, a parent or guardian agrees.)
Membership.success_body: Thank you. The club will review your application and contact you soon.
Membership.renew_success_body: Your membership will be extended once the club has confirmed it.
Membership.renew_nic_hint: Required if your membership has a NIC number on it.
Membership.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Membership.error_file_large: That file is larger than 4 MB. Choose a smaller one.
Membership.error_duplicate: A membership or application with these details already exists. Please contact the club.
Membership.error_rate: Too many attempts from this connection. Please try again a little later.
Membership.error_closed: The club is not taking applications online at the moment.
Membership.error_busy: The club has a lot of applications waiting. Please contact the club directly.
Membership.error_no_match: No approved membership matches those details. Check the phone number and NIC, or contact the club.
Membership.error_renew_waiting: A renewal for this membership is already waiting for the club to review.
Membership.error_shared_phone: More than one membership uses that phone number. Please contact the club to renew.

Parents.meta_title: For parents | Kavery Education Development Association
Parents.meta_description: Parents of KEDA students: see your child's exam marks, attendance and class announcements with the student card.
Parents.title: For parents
Parents.lead: See your child's marks, attendance and KEDA's announcements. Scan the student card, or enter the index number and the phone number your child was registered with.
Parents.scan_body: Point the camera at the square code on your child's KEDA card.
Parents.scan_camera_error: The camera could not be opened. Allow camera access, or use the index number instead.
Parents.phone_hint: The phone number given when your child was registered.
Parents.error_no_match: Those details do not match a student. Check them and try again, or ask KEDA.
Parents.error_rate: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
Parents.error_not_a_card: That is not a KEDA student card.
Parents.error_bad_number: Enter the index number as it appears on the card, for example KEDA/27/1000.
Parents.error_bad_phone: Enter the phone number your child was registered with.
Parents.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Parents.stay_note: This phone stays signed in for 30 days. On a shared phone, use Sign out.
Parents.notice_leave: {count} classes missed. Please make sure your child attends, or tell KEDA why they could not.
Parents.attendance_empty: No class registers have been marked for your child yet.
Parents.alerts_cta: Get class notices on this phone
